title: Instagram and Messenger
intro: Connect an account and reply to its customers from Inbox.
help: Staff can send text, JPEG/PNG images, PDFs, supported audio and MP4 video files for 24 hours after a customer message. Bot text replies are optional per account. Incoming attachments go to staff for review.
loadError: Could not load channels. Refresh to try again.
actionError: The change could not be completed. Refresh accounts and try again.
empty: No Instagram or Messenger accounts connected.
disconnectHelp: Disconnect cancels queued replies and stops new messages here. Revoke access at Meta separately if needed.
disconnectPrompt: Disconnect this account and cancel its queued replies?
tokenHelp: Use an account token with messaging and webhook permissions. We verify access before connecting and store the token encrypted. The token field is cleared after every attempt.
denied: Only workspace owners and admins can manage messaging accounts.
conflictError: This account or channel type is already connected. Check existing connections before trying again.
busyError: A reply is being sent. Wait for it to finish, then disconnect the account again.
unavailableError: Messaging setup is unavailable. Ask your platform administrator to check its configuration.
permissionError: Meta could not verify this account or its messaging permissions. Check the selected channel, account ID and token.
validationError: Check the selected channel, account ID and token, then try again.
cleanupError: Meta subscription cleanup could not be confirmed. Ask your Meta administrator to remove this app’s account subscription before retrying.
sessionError: Sign in as a workspace owner or admin to manage this account.
oauthHelp: Sign in at Meta, grant messaging permissions and choose the account to connect.
oauthSetup: Ask your platform administrator to configure Meta authorization.
oauthError: Authorization could not be loaded or updated. Check your workspace and sign-in, then retry.
oauthComplete: Account connected. You can now reply from Inbox.
oauthDenied: Meta authorization was declined. You can start again when ready.
oauthExpired: Authorization expired. Start again to connect.
oauthFailed: Meta could not complete authorization. Check permissions and start again.
oauthNoAccounts: No eligible accounts were returned. Check Page access and linked professional Instagram accounts, then authorize again.
oauthCleanup: Meta subscription cleanup could not be confirmed. Refresh accounts and ask your administrator to reconcile the connection before retrying.
oauthWaiting: Waiting for Meta authorization or account verification…
botEnabled: Bot replies enabled for this account
botDisabled: Bot replies off for this account
botHelp: The workspace bot must also be live. Answers use your workspace knowledge and AI quota. Existing staff conversations need Hand back to bot in Inbox; requests needing other help go to staff.
botBusyError: A bot reply is being sent. Wait for it to finish before changing bot replies.
